name: Modèles IA optionnels
description: Installs the optional neural models used by the other extensions (RIFE, SPAN, Beat This, HT Demucs, SigLIP 2, Robust Video Matting). Nothing is bundled: each entry downloads one model from its publisher after showing its licence (a dialog in the window; `ml.install` with acceptLicense in scripts), checks its SHA-256 and keeps it in the models folder (FILMCRAFT_ML_MODELS_DIR or <data folder>/models/ml). `Liste` says what is installed.
author: FilmCraft
